subject: Next steps — technical deep-dive & rotating time slots
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — technical deep-dive & rotating time slots

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for taking time with us this morning — really useful to hear about Ava Health's query volumes and the two main High-Priority flows you mentioned (patient-chat routing and anonymized analytics embeddings). Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (short):
- Primary goals: sub-200ms p50 on patient-chat, cost < $0.0009/token on embeddings pipeline
- Data constraints: PHI redaction upstream, retention window 90 days, customer-owned keys
- Stakeholders: Emma (product), Omar (security/R&D), and a couple data-engineers for the deep-dive

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical deep-dive + live demo where we:
1) walk the production inference topology we recommend,
2) review quantization/throughput tradeoffs we saw for similar workloads,
3) run a short live infer/demo on a small sample request shape.

Because your team is distributed, we suggest running this as a recurring rotational slot (three-week rotation) so the same core folks across US/EU/APAC can attend at least one slot that works for them. Below are three rotation proposals — pick the one that maps best to your org's availability and we will calendar it and share invites.

Rotation options (each is a repeating weekly meeting with a 3-week rotation window):
A) US-friendly primary: 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST — best for east/west US and late EU attendees
B) EU-centered primary: 16:00 BST / 11:00 ET / 00:00 JST — better for EU + early APAC (shifted later for some APAC)
C) APAC-shifted: 08:00 AET / 23:00 BST (previous day) / 14:00 PT — guarantees one APAC-morning slot per rotation

Action items for Ava: please confirm:
- preferred rotation pattern (A/B/C) or suggest a hybrid cadence,
- list of folks who must be invited each rotation (names + emails),
- any calendar blackout dates in July.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (outline), requirements_matrix.xlsx (what we'll ask you to fill before the deep-dive).

Proposed owners: I will schedule the first two rotations; Ben will own the demo scripts and Karthik will join for architecture/Q&A.

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Lawson <emma@avahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Omar Khan <omar@avahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 17:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps — technical deep-dive & rotating time slots

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap. Omar and I reviewed the options with the data-eng leads. We like the idea of a rotating slot so we don't keep leaving anyone out. A few quick notes: 

- Option A is closest to our preference overall, but we have a standing conflict every other Tuesday starting 10:30 PT.
- Option B works for most of our EU engineers but it edges late for some of the APAC team.
- If we do a 3-week rotation, we'd like to ensure the APAC-facing week lands at least once in the first two rotations (they're time-sensitive this month).

We can commit to the deep-dive next week if you can do a slot that matches Option A but start at 11:00 PT (it's only a 1-hour shift). Otherwise Option B + a one-off APAC session works.

Emma
Product Lead, Ava Health
emma@avahealth.com | +44 20 7946 0871

On Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 10:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking time with us this morning — really useful to hear about Ava Health's query volumes...

Thanks Emma — great notes. Proposal to keep momentum:

1) For next week's deep-dive let's pick a shifted-A: 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 BST (60 minutes). That should avoid your Tuesday conflict and keep the slot friendly to EU.

2) Establish the 3-week rotation pattern as: Week 1 = shifted-A (US-friendly), Week 2 = B (EU-centered), Week 3 = C (APAC-shifted). That guarantees the APAC-friendly slot lands at least once within the first rotation window.

3) I'll send a calendar invite for the next three occurrences and mark the first as a live demo slot. If we need an extra APAC-only deep-dive in week 1, we can add a one-off that day — will coordinate after your confirmation.

Please confirm the attendee list for invites (suggested so far):
- Emma Lawson <emma@avahealth.com>
- Omar Khan <omar@avahealth.com>
- Riya Patel <riya@avahealth.com> (data-eng) — please add if she should be included

If that looks good I'll: attach the agenda, create the rotating invites, and drop the requirements_matrix.xlsx for your engineers to fill (lightweight).

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (attached), requirements_matrix.xlsx (attached)
Calendar (provisional): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=rotating-deep-dive
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/RD-8391

Thanks — over to you for final headcount.

Best,
Soojin
